overal.goal: assertWebhookUrl accepts any http(s) URL except the server's own hostname and port, so an admin key can register http://169.254.169.254/... or http://10.0.0.5:9200/_bulk and boof POSTs signed JSON there with retries for an hour; names resolving to 127.0.0.1 are not caught either. Reject literal loopback/link-local/private ranges, resolve the host at delivery time and re-check, and keep a settings escape hatch for intentionally private endpoints.
overal.stack: TypeScript monorepo (Node 22 / Bun), Hono server, React + Vite UI, vitest

rules.do: Read README.md and docs/boof-runner.md for the intended behaviour before changing code.
Write a failing test first, then make it pass; keep the change focused on this goal.
Run `npm run typecheck && npm test` and `npm run lint` before finishing.
rules.dont: Do not change public API or MCP shapes without updating docs/api.md and the OpenAPI document.
Do not commit secrets, data roots or build output.

versions.version: Identified during the 2026-10-27 review; not started.

Webhook URLs are refused for loopback, link-local, private, CGNAT, multicast, reserved, mapped and NAT64 addresses by literal and by DNS answer at creation and before every delivery (blocked attempts are retried, never sent); security.allowedPrivateWebhookHosts is the escape hatch. Residual: no connection pinning (needs undici).

tests.strategy: Unit tests with vitest for the changed module; an integration test through the Hono app or CLI where the behaviour is observable there.
